findings.text: the negative control is a hand-authored transcript with no committed harness: the commit adds no script that produces this log, so a reader cannot re-run the mutation from the repository, only read four lines of prose; I reproduced the mechanism itself by loading the census's own catches_import_error and module_level_imports over a synthetic try/except-ImportError module and got guarded=True, then False for the except-ValueError mutation, so the claim is true but is not independently re-runnable from what is conveyed as evidence

the gate log's header records revision=4d51fba1a, the node's base, rather than the appraised head a9d01979a, so the log alone does not identify the content the census scanned; the manifest argues the two agree because nothing under nova/ changes between them and I closed the gap by re-running the manifest's command at head a9d01979a and obtaining the same 205-row finding set, so this is a labelling weakness rather than a false result

item_verdicts.call_sites: the census reports 205 findings across 119 distinct modules under nova/, dominated by 100 jax imports and 36 matplotlib imports
item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit a9d01979a against its parent 4d51fba1a; it adds benchmarks/optional_extra_import_census.py (418 lines), the optional-extra-imports report set (report.md, report.json, census.log, negative-control.log), a 3-line plan comment under data-section s1, and a 48-line evidence anchor in docs/evidence/archive/forward-solve-api-landed.html
item_verdicts.done_when: the evidence fence names the script, its two outputs, the extra-only criterion, the try/except ImportError exclusion, the vedo control, the committed log and the untouched nova/; all present: benchmarks/optional_extra_import_census.py is committed and reads [project.dependencies] and [project.optional-dependencies] via tomllib, report.md and report.json exist, the vedo control is reported found and the script returns 1 when the control is missing, the log is committed beside the report, and the commit touches no path under nova/
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is a report listing every nova core module that imports at module level a package declared only in an optional extra of pyproject.toml; I independently recomputed the census from pyproject.toml, importlib.metadata.packages_distributions and a fresh ast walk of nova/ at the appraised head a9d01979a and obtained an identical 205-row finding set with an empty two-way set difference, identical extras attribution, the same 197-runtime / 8-annotation split and the same 13 guarded exclusions, so the report is complete and not merely self-consistent
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports status complete with one commit, the census command and its counts, the negative_control_log path with a one-line note, and the base-versus-head revision disclosure under evidence_inputs
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares benchmarks/optional_extra_import_census.py, docs/figures/forward-solve-api/optional-extra-imports, docs/evidence/archive/forward-solve-api-landed.html, docs/figures/forward-solve-api and docs/plans/forward-solve-api.html; the single commit a9d01979a touches exactly 7 files, all inside those fence entries, and git show --name-only a9d01979a | grep -c '^nova/' returns 0

justifications.durability: the script is committed, deterministic given the tree and the installed environment, and re-running the manifest's command at the appraised head reproduced the exact finding set, so the deliverable is durable; the declared negative control is not committed as a harness, so its own claim survives only as a transcript even though I reproduced the mechanism with the script's primitives
justifications.evidence: the census reproduces exactly at the appraised head a9d01979a; the positive control nova/geometry/section.py:8 vedo is a genuine unguarded module-level import present in the source at both revisions and the script exits nonzero at line 411 when the control is missing, so the control can fail; two weaknesses remain: the gate log's header names the node base revision rather than the appraised head, and the negative control has no committed harness
justifications.fit: the census is ast-based and follows the repository's benchmark-script shape, no symbol or filename introduces a forbidden plan or ticket label, and the report set lives under the conventional docs/figures/<topic>/ path with no figure published because the census is naturally a table
justifications.goal_fidelity: the report lists every unguarded module-level import of a package provided by an extra and by no core dependency, with module path, line, package and extras; my independent recomputation at head produced the same 205 rows with an empty diff in both directions and the positive control reproduced
justifications.scope_discipline: the single commit touches exactly the seven declared paths and no path under nova/; the pre-solve and post-solve deliverables both sit inside the docs/ and benchmarks/ entries of the fence
